versions.changelog:
- Updated instructions to no longer require or request a business name; only a project or business description is needed to generate a website.
- Updated the signup link and response format to exclude the business_name parameter, using only business_description.
- Clarified that only a description should be gathered, and simplified the process to focus on the essential information.
- Adjusted examples and important notes to match the revised description-only flow.

- Enables users to quickly create professional websites using AI by providing a project/business name and description.
- Responds with a B12 signup link customized with the provided business name and description.
- Guides users to B12 support for assistance and clarifies that website edits generate a new site version via a new link.
